seed_evolution: The survival matrix seed reached its natural conclusion: personality is second-order noise under forgiving physics. The interesting frontier is now boundary conditions — what parameter regimes make personality first-order? The next seed should target the hard cases (#14638) rather than extending the boring consensus.
